definitions.candidate_heldout_evaluation_mean: unweighted mean of evaluation-half randomized category means over the candidate top-k set; higher is better
definitions.ce: standard-only observed-user-category-cell-equal demeaned ranking score; the omitted P8 random scalar anchor cannot change ranks
definitions.rw: standard-only production-row-exposure-weighted demeaned ranking score; the omitted P8 random scalar anchor cannot change ranks
definitions.selection_topk_overlap: intersection with the selection-half randomized-reference top-k divided by k
definitions.split_reference_regret: held-out evaluation-half mean of the selection-half reference top-k minus held-out evaluation-half mean of the candidate top-k; signed, lower is better, and negative is possible
definitions.tie_rule: sort by descending score, then ascending category string label for exact ties

familywise_regret_contrasts_vs_naive.contrast_definition: estimator split-reference regret minus naive split-reference regret; negative favors the estimator
familywise_regret_contrasts_vs_naive.family_definition: all CE-minus-naive and RW-minus-naive split-reference-regret contrasts across the pre-specified k=5,10,20 cutoffs
familywise_regret_contrasts_vs_naive.method: single-step paired-user bootstrap standardized max-|t| interval; each contrast uses its across-draw bootstrap SD and the common critical value is the confidence quantile of the draw-wise maximum absolute standardized deviation from the point estimate

nominal_ci95_metadata.note: use familywise_regret_contrasts_vs_naive for the pre-specified six-contrast multiplicity-adjusted decision claim family

ce.definition: estimator minus naive within the same bootstrap draw
ce.interpretation: negative regret contrast and positive held-out-value contrast favor the estimator

rw.definition: estimator minus naive within the same bootstrap draw
rw.interpretation: negative regret contrast and positive held-out-value contrast favor the estimator

ce.definition: estimator minus naive within the same bootstrap draw
ce.interpretation: negative regret contrast and positive held-out-value contrast favor the estimator

rw.definition: estimator minus naive within the same bootstrap draw
rw.interpretation: negative regret contrast and positive held-out-value contrast favor the estimator

ce.definition: estimator minus naive within the same bootstrap draw
ce.interpretation: negative regret contrast and positive held-out-value contrast favor the estimator

rw.definition: estimator minus naive within the same bootstrap draw
rw.interpretation: negative regret contrast and positive held-out-value contrast favor the estimator

paired_scope.definition: standard users with at least min_categories, intersected with random user IDs; common-video and standard-coverage restrictions iterated to a fixed point

split_design.evaluation_role: value the reference and candidate top-k sets only
split_design.name: frozen outcome-free randomized-event hash split
